tasks.final_text: The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics> It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.

I just watched Howls moving castle again and I absolutely loved it. It's a really pretty movie and all of the characters have a ton of depth. But my favorite part is obviously the music, Its incredible. If you've never listened to Merry Go Round of Life I would seriously recommend it. I reached my words :)
